notes: One row = one render job (plugin config + signal + sample rate).
Knob values are UI units (0-10); normalized mapping comes from dump_fx_params.lua at stage 3.
Static signal level -12 dBFS is a working hypothesis; may be revised after level-dependence results.
Every render must carry a passport per docs/RESEARCH_EQ_MARKET.md section 8.
conditional=true rows wait for stage-2 dump confirmation before rendering.

impulse.description: unit impulse, 200 ms leading silence, 5 s total, peak 0 dBFS

sweep_log.description: log sweep 1 Hz .. 0.45*SR, 15 s, 50 ms fades, -12 dBFS

sine_50.description: sine 50 Hz, 10 s; level defines grid row (level_dbfs)

sine_100.description: sine 100 Hz, 10 s; level defines grid row (level_dbfs)

sine_1000.description: sine 1000 Hz, 10 s; level defines grid row (level_dbfs)

twotone_50_1000.description: two-tone IMD 50 Hz + 1000 Hz, 10 s; level defines grid row
